name: Off-Highway Motorcycle
description: An electric motorcycle built for off-highway use, such as an electric dirt bike, ridden under the off-highway category of each classification naming this group. A vehicle carries this group's id in place of each classification in it, and each of those holds its own jurisdiction's license, registration, insurance, helmet and riding rules.

restrictions.rule: Built by its manufacturer for off-highway use, not for the road
restrictions.citation: 49 U.S.C. §30102(a)(7); Illinois Vehicle Code §1-153.1; Utah Code §41-22-2

restrictions.rule: No limit on motor power or speed
restrictions.citation: Illinois Vehicle Code §1-153.1; Utah Code §41-22-2; Wisconsin Statutes §23.335(1)(q)

restrictions.rule: Kept off public roads except where its jurisdiction allows it
restrictions.citation: Ohio Revised Code §4519.40; Revised Code of Washington §46.09.450
